flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:4173/ then Open Hati with no saved data (clear this site's browser storage and reload if any bills or people exist).
Add the people Ana, Ben and Cy.
Click Add bill and enter the name Water.
Enter the amount 0 and choose Ana, Ben and Cy.
Try to save the bill and read the message shown.
Assert The message "Enter an amount greater than 0" is shown.
Assert The Water bill does not appear in the bill list.
Store The error message text shown after trying to save the bill as 'amount_error'.

summary:
Opened Hati with a clean starting state and added Ana, Ben, and Cy.
Created a new bill named Water, entered an amount of 0, and selected all three people.
Tried to save the bill; Hati displayed “Enter an amount greater than 0.”
The Water bill was not added to the bill list.
